simple.meaning: בָּזָק (bâzâq) is a Hebrew word meaning “a flash of lightning.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

definitions.full: H965. bazaq בָּזָק noun [masculine] lightning flash ? Ezek 1:14 Hi Co strike out; verse omitted in old MSS. of ᵐ5 ; sense uncertain, possibly error for ברק .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to lighten;

occurrences.englishText: The living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning.
